title: How to automate credit spread
author: ogb-officials
selftext:
You don't need a complicated trading strategy.

I've been testing this live for the past two weeks, and I'll share screenshots of the results.

The strategy is simple. Tell your AI agent:

"At a specific time each day, analyze historical data, find a suitable credit spread, open the trade, target 10% profit, and set a 30% stop loss."

The agent handles everything from entry to exit, following your predefined rules.

Now, let's look at the numbers.

Assume you allocate $2,000 per trade:

Each win (10%): +$200

Each loss (30%): −$600

15 trades per month, skipping major news and market events.

Here's what a month could look like:

15 wins, 0 losses = +$3,000 (150%)

14 wins, 1 loss = +$2,200 (110%)

13 wins, 2 losses = +$1,400 (70%)

These are projections based on fixed position sizing, not my actual two-week returns. Fees, slippage, and losses beyond the stop can reduce results.

The interesting part is that your AI agent doesn't need to predict every market move. It needs a tested strategy, clear rules, and proper risk management.

I've been testing this approach live, and I'll attach screenshots so you can see the results.
